gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-epilogue: Loose, rope-ladder lettering with a lazy grin. Delius Unicase keeps every stroke blunt and untapered, while Epilogue's wire-thin, curvy plain sans lets that looseness land without a fuss.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans arrives with a larger-than-usual x-height and s curves that open wide. Delius Unicase hand-lettered headings sit above it, relaxed and blunt-ended, so the page feels friendly yet tidy.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-public-sans: Trustworthy is the first word for Public Sans, a hefty-bodied sans with broad open counters. Public Sans underneath Delius Unicase, whose lines hold their width through every turn, would read steady and sturdy, with the handwriting up top loosening the mood.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, a thick, heavy-looking band of text with letters held open rather than curled shut. And Delius Unicase on top brings the loose, handwritten warmth, its stroke thickness staying put around every curve.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-satoshi: Satoshi reads approachable and spacious, with a soaring x-height and an e that never squeezes shut, every stroke cut to one width. Beside Delius Unicase it feels like a friendly handshake.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-switzer: Hand-lettered looseness meets Swiss tidiness. Delius Unicase is best at relaxed, untapered warmth, while Switzer, a sans-serif of tubular, wire-like letterforms and a tall waist line, is best at keeping things crisp.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-work-sans: Casual handwriting over modern structure. Delius Unicase gives a relaxed, blunt-ended greeting, and Work Sans, a sans-serif with a high mean line and joins as thick as its strokes, keeps the page grounded.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-asap: Asap reads clearly, its open-arc c forms and body height nearly matching the capitals. Asap, a sans, gives Fuzzy Bubbles' bent-pipe handwriting a steady footing so the personal touch stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-epilogue: Approachable and a bit curvy, Epilogue leads the reading. Its tall-bodied lowercase and wire-like skeleton would carry a long page smoothly, with Fuzzy Bubbles' drafting-pen handwriting adding a personal note.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-erode: Dignified Erode sets a serif tone with a faint crayon-like thick-thin rhythm. Under Fuzzy Bubbles, whose stroke widths stay put from stem to curve, it gives the handwriting an editorial anchor.
